description: Fresh triage cases written on 2026-09-24 after the v2 rules and the held-out set, by the same author as the rules (so not independent). Run blind once: rules alone caught 13 of 15 redirect cases and cleared 15 of 15 benign cases. The two misses ('huge painful lumps under the skin...' was then caught only by the model second opinion; 'numb and pale after the sunburn' by nothing) led to rule changes on 2026-09-25 (the lump rule now also matches 'lumps'; new numbness, lost-sensation and pale-after-burn rules), so this set is no longer unbiased. The independent set (npm run eval:independent) is the unbiased test.

missed: huge painful lumps under the skin on my jaw that leave scars
patch of skin went numb and pale after the sunburn
